comparison.objective: Refit a sprung parallel-rod pair onto four ball joints.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lifting, controlled spring spreading, multi-point alignment, and snap fitting.
comparison.success_condition: Four cups are seated on their balls and released without dropping or overstretching the pair.
comparison.reason: Shares bimanual force regulation and small-feature alignment, but tests elastic spreading and snap attachment rather than impact separation and post-fracture debris recovery.
